## Goal
Make the repo safe for 50 concurrent agent PRs: required checks, auto-merge, CODEOWNERS on contracts and IAM, dev/prod environments.

## Owns
- `scripts/github/**`
- `.github/rulesets/**`
- `.github/labels.json`
- `.github/CODEOWNERS`
- `.github/pull_request_template.md`

## Tests first (write them, see them fail, then implement)
- scripts/github/verify.sh that asserts (via gh api) the ruleset, required check names, auto-merge, delete-branch-on-merge, environments.

## Steps
- Run scripts/github/setup.sh against the repo (the owner provides GH_ADMIN_TOKEN).
- Confirm required check names exactly match job names in .github/workflows/ci.yml and claude-review.yml.
- If the plan lacks rulesets on private repos, fall back to classic branch protection and document it.
- Enable merge queue if available (CI already listens to merge_group).

## Acceptance
- verify.sh passes.
- A test PR with a failing check cannot merge; a green one auto-merges.

## Run
`bash scripts/github/verify.sh` and `make test` before opening the PR.
